summary: John Boehner and Roy Blunt emerge as the two candidates vying to replace Tom DeLay as US House majority leader.
At CPAC, House Minority Leader John Boehner spoke against President Obama's stimulus bill and legislative agenda, calling the stimulus the "opening salvo" in an assault on American economic freedoms.
Tiger Woods selects Republican House Minority Leader John Boehner as one of his partners for the pro-am at the AT&T National event at Congressional Country Club.
John Boehner is scheduled to appear at a pre-election rally with Republican House candidate Rich Iott, who has been criticized for his past as a Nazi reenactor.
John Boehner is in line to become the third most powerful person in the US after sweeping Republican gains in the midterm elections.
John Boehner choked up in tears while recounting his own accomplishments after the Republican midterm election victory.
John Boehner is set to become the Republican leader of the US House of Representatives, and thus the third most powerful person in the country, after the Republicans won control of the House.
John Boehner is set to become the new Republican speaker of the House of Representatives following the Republicans' midterm election victory, with his close ties to lobbyists drawing scrutiny.

In a 60 Minutes interview, House speaker-elect John Boehner said President Barack Obama showed him "disrespect" by calling him a hostage-taker and became emotional while discussing the American dream.
Republican John Boehner was elected Speaker of the House, replacing Democrat Nancy Pelosi.

House Speaker John Boehner and Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell declare they will reject a short-term extension of government spending without further cuts, raising the possibility of a government shutdown.

House Speaker John Boehner pushes through $61bn in federal spending cuts as the Republican-controlled House votes 235-192 to pass the measures, setting up a showdown with President Obama and the Democrat-controlled Senate.

The Senate approved a House-passed continuing resolution funding the federal government until 8 April, with House Speaker John Boehner facing a rebellion from 54 Tea Party-backed House Republicans who voted against the bill.
House Speaker John Boehner faces pressure from rightwing Tea Party Republicans pushing for $61bn in cuts as talks with Democrats and President Obama fail to avert a possible government shutdown.

House Republican leaders privately warn Speaker John Boehner that they may not have the votes to pass a six-month spending bill with significantly less than $61 billion in cuts, as Boehner, Senate Democrats, and the White House zero in on $33 billion in spending cuts.
White House and Republican-led House, including Speaker John Boehner, failed to reach a budget agreement, leaving the US federal government facing a shutdown.
Republican leaders John Boehner and Mitch McConnell, along with President Obama, agree that the debt ceiling must be raised, while Representative Michele Bachmann opposes the hike.
Negotiations between Barack Obama and House Republican leader John Boehner over the US debt crisis collapsed after Boehner refused to return the president's phone calls.
House Speaker John Boehner's debt ceiling negotiations with President Barack Obama broke down, with Boehner facing difficulty selling any deal to his Tea Party-infused Republican caucus.

President Barack Obama and Republican Congress speaker John Boehner are divided over the US debt crisis ahead of the 2 August deadline when the government will no longer be able to pay its bills within its debt ceiling.

House Speaker John Boehner faces pressure from Tea Party members threatening to withhold support over his willingness to compromise with the administration on raising the debt ceiling to avoid a US government default.

House Speaker John Boehner claims President Obama's use of executive privilege over the Fast and Furious documents is an admission of White House involvement, escalating the row with Attorney General Eric Holder.
John Boehner joins criticism of Michele Bachmann over her allegations linking Hillary Clinton aide Huma Abedin to the Muslim Brotherhood, calling the accusations "pretty dangerous."
John Boehner dismissed the latest White House fiscal cliff proposals as "not serious" and said negotiations were at a stalemate.
Republican leader John Boehner said he was “flabbergasted” by Treasury Secretary Tim Geithner’s fiscal cliff plan and renewed his opposition to increased tax rates for the wealthy.

President Barack Obama and House Speaker John Boehner met privately at the White House to discuss the fiscal cliff negotiations, their first meeting since Republicans presented counter proposals a week earlier.

A revolt by Tea Party-linked members of his own party killed the tax bill John Boehner had championed as a solution to the fiscal cliff, prompting questions about whether he could survive as House speaker.

House Speaker John Boehner signaled he would not quit after failing to pass his "Plan B" fiscal cliff bill, effectively abandoning negotiations with the White House and shifting responsibility to the Senate.
House Speaker John Boehner voted for the bipartisan fiscal cliff agreement while House Majority Leader Eric Cantor opposed it, splitting the House Republican leadership.
John Boehner is re-elected as Speaker of the House of Representatives despite dissent within the Republican party.
House Speaker John Boehner admonishes Republican colleague Don Young over his use of a racial slur to describe Hispanic immigrants, calling the remarks offensive and demanding an immediate apology.
Treasury Secretary Jack Lew warns House Speaker John Boehner that the US will hit its borrowing limit in mid-October and could soon be unable to pay all its bills.
House Speaker John Boehner announces Republicans will pass a budget bill including measures to defund the Affordable Care Act, setting up a showdown with President Obama.
House Speaker John Boehner appeals for talks amid a US federal government shutdown.
Obama challenges House Speaker John Boehner to allow a clean budget vote to end the government shutdown, disputing Boehner's claim that there are not enough votes in the House to pass it.

House Speaker John Boehner criticized conservative groups that opposed the bipartisan budget deal before seeing it, saying they are using Republican members and the American people for their own goals.

House Speaker John Boehner tells fellow Republicans he will bring a "clean" debt limit bill to a vote without policy conditions, backing away from a confrontation with the White House over the US borrowing limit.
House Speaker John Boehner launches a lawsuit against President Barack Obama for failing to consult Congress before taking executive action to adjust implementation of the Affordable Care Act.
House Speaker John Boehner warned that President Obama would face "big trouble" and that immigration reform would have "no chance" if Obama used executive action on immigration.
House Speaker John Boehner accused President Obama of undermining the rule of law and damaging the presidency with executive actions on immigration.
Representative Louie Gohmert announced he is challenging John Boehner for the House speaker job.
John Boehner survived a long-shot challenge to his leadership and was re-elected Speaker of the House, securing 216 of 408 votes despite 25 Republican congressmen voting against him.
John Boehner is expected to face a challenge to his re-election as Speaker of the House from Tea Party-aligned Republicans as Republicans take control of Congress.

House Speaker John Boehner said communications intercepted under the FISA program foiled a planned Capitol shooting plot, an explanation at odds with the FBI criminal complaint, which attributed the case to a confidential informant.

A former bartender, Michael Hoyt, was charged with threatening to kill House Speaker John Boehner by poisoning his drink, though the suspect showed signs of severe mental illness and no longer worked at the country club at the time of his arrest.
House Speaker John Boehner invites Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu to address a joint session of Congress on Iran, without consulting the White House.

House Speaker John Boehner’s invitation to Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu to address Congress sparks controversy and appears to encourage wavering Democrats to rally around President Obama on Iran policy.

House Speaker John Boehner reportedly told party members at a closed-door session that he is finalizing legal options for another lawsuit against President Obama over his executive action on immigration.
House Speaker John Boehner announced that Pope Francis will address a joint meeting of Congress on 24 September during his visit to Washington DC.

Republican House Speaker John Boehner invited Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu to address Congress, prompting three prominent US Democrats to threaten to skip the speech amid anger over perceived partisan lobbying.
Republican leader John Boehner invited Israeli Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu to address Congress on the risks of a nuclear deal with Iran.
House Speaker John Boehner dismissed reports that conservative rivals were planning to oust him following a deal to avert a shutdown of the Department of Homeland Security.
House Speaker John Boehner announced he would allow a vote on a "clean" funding bill for the Department of Homeland Security, ending a months-long standoff over immigration.
House Speaker John Boehner urges Hillary Clinton to turn over all her emails to a neutral third party amid controversy over her use of a private email account while serving as secretary of state.
House Speaker John Boehner announced he will resign from Congress effective October 30, following pressure from conservative House Republicans.
Congress votes to keep the government funded until 11 December, sending a continuing resolution to the president in what will be John Boehner's final budget fight as speaker of the House.
The far-right Freedom Caucus announces it will vote as a bloc for Daniel Webster to replace John Boehner as speaker, complicating Kevin McCarthy's expected election.

House Speaker John Boehner announced that the election for a new House speaker was postponed after Majority Whip Kevin McCarthy withdrew from the race, and said he would continue serving as speaker until the House elects a new one.
House Democrats may view outgoing Speaker John Boehner's departure with nostalgia as the Freedom Caucus consolidates power, though Boehner's retirement had been announced earlier.
John Boehner called Paul Ryan twice to ask him to run for speaker of the House after Kevin McCarthy withdrew from the race.
Pressure mounts on Paul Ryan to run for House speaker as John Boehner is set to step down at the end of October amid Republican turmoil.

After John Boehner announced his resignation as House speaker and presumptive successor Kevin McCarthy withdrew, Paul Ryan emerged as a possible unifying choice for speaker, though he had not yet decided to run.
Paul Ryan put himself forward conditionally as a compromise candidate to replace John Boehner as House speaker.
Paul Ryan formally announces his candidacy to replace John Boehner as Speaker of the House.
Former House speaker John Boehner told Stanford students that Ted Cruz is "Lucifer in the flesh" and a "miserable son of a bitch."
